features: 10000mAh Li-Polymer Battery – Provides reliable portable power backup for smartphones, tablets, earbuds and other USB devices.
22.5W Fast Output Charging – Supports fast charging through Type-C output with PPS compatibility for supported devices.
Magnetic Wireless Charging Technology – Strong magnetic attachment with up to 15W wireless charging support.
Built-in Charging Cables – Comes with integrated Type-C and Lightning cables for convenient on-the-go charging.
Universal Compatibility – USB-A and Type-C output ports support charging for a wide range of devices.
description: Stay powered wherever you go with the EVM EnMag 17 Pro 10000mAh Magnetic Power Bank. Featuring a premium Li-Polymer battery, this compact charger offers dependable power backup with a stylish and portable design.Equipped with 22.5W fast charging capability, PPS support and multiple output options, it provides efficient charging for smartphones and USB-powered devices. The built-in Type-C and Lightning cables make charging easier without the hassle of carrying additional wires.The magnetic wireless charging feature provides up to 15W wireless output and supports MagSafe-compatible cases for a seamless charging experience. Ideal for travel, office and everyday use, the EnMag 17 Pro delivers performance, convenience and reliability backed by a 2-year warranty.
